sections.title: Operating Principles
paras: Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:
We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.
bullets: Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.
Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.
Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.
Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

sections.title: AI-First by Default
paras: We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.
That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:

We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.
bullets: Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.
Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.
Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.
Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.

As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

sections.title: ABOUT THE ROLE
paras: Rain is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own our onchain surface — the blockchain layer that everything else at Rain depends on. Stablecoins only work as real-world money if the onchain side is fast, safe, and invisible: collateral held in contracts, settlement across chains, custody and wallet architecture, and the asset and network coverage our partners need to operate globally. This role owns that.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll be the directly responsible PM for onchain end to end: smart contracts and protocol design, chain and asset integrations, settlement and treasury flows, and the infrastructure underneath it all. You'll work closely with engineering, security, compliance, legal, and directly with our fintech, neobank, and institutional partners.

sections.title: WHAT YOU'LL DO
bullets: Own the roadmap for Rain's onchain product — smart contracts, chain and asset coverage, settlement, and payments — and drive it end to end

Partner deeply with engineering on protocol and infrastructure tradeoffs (contract architecture and upgradeability, collateralization and liquidation logic, node/RPC reliability, gas and fee strategy, bridging and cross-chain messaging) and translate them into partner-facing product decisions

Decide which chains, assets, and stablecoins Rain supports and when — build the framework for those calls across liquidity, security, cost, partner demand, compliance considerations, and regulatory exposure
Drive the security bar for onchain work — audits, monitoring, incident response, and the operational guardrails that go with holding real value onchain
Translate complex protocol and blockchain infrastructure into intuitive product surfaces and clear partner-facing documentation
Gather feedback directly from partners, distill it into sharp prioritization, and push the team toward the highest-leverage work
Measure ruthlessly, iterate quickly, and set a bar others want to work to

sections.title: WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
bullets: 8-10 years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping products from zero-to-one through scale at a product-led company with a strong engineering culture and high bar for quality

Deep, hands-on blockchain fluency — you've shipped onchain products and can reason unaided about EVM and Solana mechanics (and other chains), smart contract design and upgrade patterns, gas economics, bridging models, and other onchain tradeoffs
Exceptional product judgment and analytical rigor — you're someone others describe as one of the sharpest PMs they've worked with, and you consistently raise the bar for the people around you
A senior, autonomous operator who can define the problem, drive the plan, and own the outcome without needing close direction

Sound instincts on onchain security and risk: you know where value gets lost, you push for audits and monitoring before incidents rather than after, and you can weigh a shipping deadline against a real risk without flinching
Strong technical fluency beyond the chain itself (APIs, distributed systems, payments and ledger design) and the instinct to pull on technical threads yourself rather than defer to engineering
Genuinely excited to live in the details — you believe product quality is won in the specifics and are energized by the work to get them right
Excellent written and verbal communication; you can operate with sophisticated external partners and internal engineering teams with equal ease

sections.title: NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT MANDATORY
bullets: Experience with stablecoin issuance, onchain lending or collateralized credit, or tokenized asset products
Background at a protocol, L1/L2, wallet, custodian, or onchain infrastructure company
Familiarity with non-EVM ecosystems (Solana, Tron, Bitcoin L2s) and multi-chain operations at scale
Experience with payments, card issuing, or cross-border fintech products
Working knowledge of the regulatory landscape around digital assets and custody
Previous startup or hypergrowth environment experience

ashby:revenuecat:40a49a4f-962f-4a38-85b1.summary:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $18B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 180+ people across 30+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that…

sections.title: The role
paras: We are looking for a Head of Customer Growth to build and lead the operating system that helps RevenueCat customers become better app businesses.

This is broader than a traditional Customer Success role. It combines strategic account coverage, app-growth judgment, specialist advisory, customer education, product adoption, and scalable enablement. The goal is not to give every customer the same high-touch service. It is to identify where RevenueCat can create disproportionate value, deploy the right kind of help, and turn every successful customer intervention into knowledge that benefits the rest of the customer base.

You will lead a multi-lane Customer Growth function spanning the CSM team, Growth Advisory, Growth Advocacy, and the emerging Customer Enablement function. The CSM Team Lead will own daily CSM execution. You will set the strategy, operating model, talent bar, investment plan, and measures of success for the function as a whole.

sections.title: Why we are hiring for this role now
paras: RevenueCat serves tiny indie apps, fast-growing startups, games, media companies, health and fitness apps, AI products, marketplaces, and some of the most sophisticated consumer app businesses in the world.

The app market is top-heavy, so the human touch must be allocated deliberately. At the same time, a customer that is small today may become strategically important very quickly. Contract status and current revenue are necessary signals, but they are not sufficient.

We already have many of the ingredients: CSMs, a CSM Team Lead role, Growth Advocates, Customer Growth Advisory specialists, Product, Support, Marketing, Sales, TAM, Data, and one of the richest datasets in app monetization. We need a leader who can turn those ingredients into a coherent function.

sections.title: What you will be responsible for
bullets: Own Customer Growth strategy across the full customer base. Define how RevenueCat helps customers grow after they begin using the product, including named accounts, high-potential customers, specialist-assisted customers, scaled customers, and the long tail.

Build segmentation and coverage. Use current value, future potential, adoption, intent, growth moments, risk, and strategic importance to decide who receives named CSM coverage, time-bound help, specialist advisory, scaled education, product-led guidance, or monitoring.

Lead through the CSM Team Lead. Set the bar for customer context, account strategy, stakeholder management, growth diagnosis, adoption planning, commercial awareness, and follow-through. Develop the Team Lead and create a strong leadership bench rather than becoming the permanent CSM manager.
Identify high-potential customers early. Work with Data, Product, Sales, Marketing, and Support to find customers with meaningful future potential before revenue alone makes them obvious.

Govern Growth Advisory. Define intake, qualification, expected impact, output quality, follow-through, and reuse. Specialists should be deployed against specific high-value problems rather than become general-purpose consulting capacity.
Make Growth Advocacy a customer-education channel. Ensure Growth Advocates turn real customer learning into authoritative one-to-many education for existing customers and the broader app ecosystem.
Build Customer Enablement and Scaled Growth. Create the roadmap for lifecycle programs, templates, office hours, documentation, automation, product nudges, and next-best-action guidance.
Drive meaningful product adoption. Partner with Product and Product Marketing so customers adopt RevenueCat capabilities in ways that help them win, rather than merely increasing feature activity.

sections.title: Within the first month
bullets: Meet directly with at least 15 customers across different sizes, growth stages, product footprints, and monetization models—including high-value, high-potential, at-risk, and scaled customers.

Take point on at least two live customer-growth situations. Work alongside the CSM, Advisory, TAM, Support, or Product partner to diagnose the problem, agree ownership, and move each customer to a concrete next milestone.
Ship at least one no-regrets improvement to a broken handoff, account motion, Advisory route, or customer experience rather than waiting for a complete strategy.
Establish a clear operating agreement with the CSM Team Lead and act on urgent customer, talent, or ownership issues.
Build a working view of the team, coverage, high-potential misses, lane boundaries, and metrics—deep enough to make decisions, without allowing analysis to delay action.

ashby:socure:b48276fa-198f-4928-bdba-04e.summary:
Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: We're looking for a Senior Solution Consultant, Post-Sales to drive the successful onboarding and measurable outcomes for clients leveraging Socure's AI-powered identity verification and fraud prevention platform RiskOS. In this role, you'll sit at the intersection of cutting-edge product, machine learning and AI tools and real-world client implementation — helping organizations unlock the full potential of Socure's predictive models, automated decisioning workflows, and data-driven intelligence.

This role is ideal for someone who is self motivated, energized by AI and automation, comfortable working with data-driven decisionmaking, and eager to translate technical sophistication into tangible client value in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

sections.title: Implementation & Solution Delivery
bullets: Lead the end-to-end platform implementation process, ensuring timely and successful deployments.
Collaborate with clients to define solution architecture, configure platform components, and tailor implementations to meet specific business needs.
Develop and refine best practices for scalable, high-impact implementations.

sections.title: AI-Driven Onboarding & Implementation
bullets: Lead onboarding efforts that put AI and automation front and center — configuring Socure's intelligent decisioning engines, ML model outputs, and automated workflows to align with each client's risk and identity strategy.
Guide clients through best practices for integrating AI-powered signals into their existing tech stacks, ensuring they're positioned to get immediate value from Socure's predictive capabilities.
Translate client business goals into optimized platform configurations that leverage Socure's models to their fullest extent.

sections.title: Data Optimization & Performance Tuning
bullets: Partner with clients to analyze acceptance rates, false positive/negative trends, and model performance data — identifying opportunities to fine-tune configurations and maximize accuracy.
Use data and intelligent tools to proactively surface insights and recommendations that improve identity pass rates, reduce fraud exposure, and drive operational efficiency.
Collaborate with internal data and product teams to ensure client environments are calibrated for optimal model performance over time.

ashby:sparrow:2fa1c7ae-7853-41bb-a10a-4c.summary:
Sparrow is the first high-tech, high-touch employee leave management solution. Our mission is to make it simple for companies to provide their employees with all kinds of leave (i.e. family, medical, etc.).

Currently, the leave management process is painful and inefficient for everyone. Company leaders struggle to keep up with regulations and processes that change frequently, and the employees going on leave are overwhelmed by bureaucracy at an exceptionally important juncture in their career. Sparrow transforms this ordinarily tedious, error-prone, complex to remain compliant, and time-consuming process into a 30-minute end-to-end experience saving teams time (20 - 40 hours per leave) and money (up to $30K per leave).

sections.title: About the Role
paras: As an Account Manager at Sparrow, you’ll have the opportunity to help execute our vision and ensure that we are engaging with current customers in the moments that matter most. You will own a revenue target (both expansion and upselling), generate referrals, and work cross-functionally alongside internal stakeholders to be the voice of the customer for product and service enhancements.
bullets: Focus on increasing product adoption, leading a positive customer experience, and driving growth through gross renewals and net retention improvements.
Optimize customer lifecycle by driving programs and initiatives to improve engagement approaches based on customer segmentation.
Identify growth and expansion opportunities within our existing customer base in order to achieve your revenue targets.
Use raw customer data to identify ways to maintain a sensational customer experience.
Reduce churn and drive new business growth through greater advocacy, referenceability, and referrals.
Address escalated client issues with speed and urgency, orchestrating resources across the company as appropriate.
Conduct strategic quarterly business reviews to ensure client satisfaction and uncover thematic opportunities for improvement.
Work with the sales team as a solutions architect on sales calls to provide subject matter expertise and cross-functional resources to increase new sales conversions.

sections.title: About You:
bullets: 5+ years experience within Renewal Management, Account Management, Customer Success, or Customer Experience ideally within SaaS offerings.

2+ years experience in the leave of absence space, such as at a third-party administrator (TPA), disability or absence management carrier, leave management technology provider, or administering leave in-house.
Experience in building strategic plans for engaging with customers to ensure we’re driving connection through thoughtful touchpoints in the moments that matter.
Experience with high-touch strategic account management and a digital-first low-touch model. Understands how and when to apply each.

Data-driven approach to designing processes and approaching your work
Highly effective communicator - able to build trust and rapport quickly, work well cross-functionally and drive effective customer / client meetings in a B2B market.

sections.title: Why Sparrow?
paras: Our work at Sparrow is impactful. We help People teams with one of the hardest parts of their job, and we support employees at a time when they need it most. We’re driven by our mission, much like a nonprofit, but with the resources and scale of a fast-growing venture-backed company.

ashby:standardbots:a5a3b8f8-145c-4e54-a6.summary: Standard Bots is building the world’s most accessible robotics platform to bring advanced automation into manufacturing and beyond, with intuitive hardware and software that empower human productivity.

sections.title: Overview
paras: Industrial software has been ugly and hard to use for decades. We're trying to change that—bringing consumer-grade clarity and craft to a world that hasn't seen much of either.Most software products live on screens. Ours move metal. Your product decisions here have physical consequences. Software that's confusing doesn't just frustrate users—it stops production lines, or worse. Software that's good doesn't just get clicks—it makes a robot do something useful in the real world that it couldn't do before.

We're looking for a PM who is a builder first. Someone who wants to own the impact of a product area end-to-end. Someone who gets genuinely curious about how things work—software, hardware, customers, industries. Someone with product sense and taste who can tell the difference between "ships" and "good.”

sections.title: What You Will Do
bullets: Own product discovery, strategy, and delivery for a core area of our platform (specifics depend on your strengths and interests)
Go deep on customer problems—talk to users, visit sites, read manuals, understand how robots actually get used.
Define what we're building and why, with clear specs that engineers can run with.
Work hands-on with UX, interaction flows, and functional behavior — thinking through how an individual feature fits together with the rest of the system.
Collaborate with engineers, designers to iterate prototypes, validate assumptions, and de-risk work early.

sections.title: What We’re Looking For
bullets: 5+ years in product, design, engineering, or a similarly hands-on role.
You've built and shipped things you're proud of—not just managed process.
You think critically about customer problems and can break down ambiguity into structured decisions.
You have design sense and care about craft—you notice when something is off and it bothers you
You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience in industrial automation, AI, or robotics.

ashby:supabase:68a397e7-8a1a-4566-ae41-e.summary:
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

More than 10 million developers build on it, from solo founders shipping over a weekend to teams and builders via Vercel, Lovable and Stripe, and every one of them reaches Supabase through a surface: an API, an auth flow, an SDK, or a Partner's product with Supabase integrated.

The current and next wave of software leans on those surfaces harder than any before it.

sections.title: About Supabase
paras: Agents now act on behalf of developers and end users, authentication has to work machine-to-machine as seamlessly as it once worked human-to-human, and independent platforms increasingly need to authenticate, delegate, and coordinate with each other without a person in the loop. For a platform built on Postgres with Auth, Compute, Storage and generated Data APIs at its core, the surfaces where Supabase meets Partners and their systems are some of the most important avenues that we own - this role owns these surfaces.

This role owns a focused portfolio of those Partners. Not the platform as a whole, but a small number of strategic Partners whose integrations you are accountable for making excellent. Success here is a product measure, not a commercial one: the integration is high quality, the developers who use it are well served, and it keeps improving. That means living close to those developers, obsessing over where the integration fails them, and turning what you learn into the roadmap. It is a product and engineering job first, because the best integrations are won in architecture reviews and pull requests, not in meetings.

sections.title: What You'll Be Responsible For
bullets: Owning the success of a focused portfolio of strategic Partners, a small number of them rather than the platform as a whole. You are accountable for the outcome of each partnership: a high-quality integration that the developers who use it reach for, and that keeps getting better.

Living close to the developers who use these integrations. Talking to them constantly, finding where each integration breaks down in real use, and building the roadmap from that signal rather than from a Partner's wishlist.

Deciding the right integration model for each Partner: what Supabase owns, what the Partner owns, what you build jointly, and what stays open and Partner-agnostic, reading whether the two roadmaps run together or diverge and choosing accordingly.

Working hands-on with each Partner's product and engineering counterparts to ship. Holding your own in an architecture review and a code-level design discussion, and turning strategy into shipped, high-quality integrations rather than long conversations.
Setting the quality bar for what a great integration looks like, and building the mechanisms (documentation, tooling, guardrails, versioning) that hold every Partner to it as adoption scales.

Defining what success looks like for each integration and measure it honestly: adoption by the developers who use it, integration quality, and reliability in real use. Using those signals to decide how deep to go with each Partner and where to push the integration next.

sections.title: You Might Be a Good Fit If You:
bullets: Have 7+ years of product management on developer tools, or are an ex-founder with strong product instincts, and are technical enough to read an architecture doc, follow a design discussion, and ask the right questions.
Are based in the San Francisco Bay Area or can travel there regularly.
Are biased toward speed, and would rather ship something imperfect (but secure) while learning than spend another month polishing a spec.

Build with what you own, using the surfaces on your roadmap the way a Partner would: standing up an auth flow, calling the Data API, deploying a database, wiring Supabase into another product. You form opinions through first-hand use.
Comfortable using AI tools to compress the slower parts of the role, like research, drafting, and synthesising feedback, so you spend more time on judgment calls.
Work async by default. Supabase is fully remote, so you make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings.

sections.title: About the Team
paras: Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.
bullets: ~400 team members
60+ countries
20+ languages spoken
Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)
540,000+ community members

ashby:truemed:53657d95-a092-4261-b72a-cf.summary: Truemed helps people take control of their health by unlocking pre-tax HSA/FSA dollars for preventive care. We are building the destination for health-driven commerce — a marketplace where millions of consumers discover, buy, and return to the brands and products that make them healthier. As we scale, we need someone to own the engine that drives consumer growth: acquisition, activation, retention, and the flywheel that keeps users coming back.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: We're hiring a Growth Product Manager to own the shopping and marketplace experience on Truemed.com . You'll be responsible for turning site traffic into customers: improving conversion across the funnel, keeping the marketplace healthy, and building new shopping experiences.

This role sits at the intersection of marketing, product, and engineering. You'll be the person who connects what marketing brings to the site with what product and engineering ship, and you'll use experimentation to decide what works.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Own conversion on Truemed.com . Run a steady stream of A/B tests across landing pages, product pages and the marketplace, and turn the results into product decisions.
Build new shopping experiences. Work with engineering and design to ship new ways for customers to find and buy products.
Grow the marketplace. Improve how products are listed, merchandised and discovered, for customers and merchant partners alike.

Connect marketing, product and engineering. Work hand in hand with marketing so that bringing people to the site and turning them into customers run as one funnel. Share data, plan launches around campaigns, and shape the roadmap together.
Own the metrics. Set success metrics with leadership across discovery, click-through, purchase and revenue, and size the revenue impact of every win.
Run the experiment roadmap. Keep a ranked pipeline of hypotheses, sorted by effort, odds of success and reach × impact. Log what you learn, including the losses.

sections.title: What We're Looking For
bullets: 5+ years of product management experience, with a significant part in growth, conversion, or e-commerce roles. Or 3+ years of product management experience, with previous experience in growth marketing.
A proven track record of running A/B tests that measurably improved conversion, and you can walk us through specific tests, results, and what you learned.
Experience at a fintech, payments, or healthcare company with a consumer marketplace or shopping experience, such as Affirm, Klarna, PayPal, Ramp, or similar.
Has run a real experimentation program and can walk through tests that lost, what they learned, and how they spotted a misleading result.
Thinks in funnels and reach × impact, not feature lists, and can size an opportunity before building it.
Hands-on experience shipping e-commerce or payments flows.
Strong analytical skills: comfortable with experimentation platforms and product analytics tools, and you understand statistical significance and common testing pitfalls.
A history of working closely with marketing teams, not just engineering. You have an understanding of growth marketing economics (LTV, CAC, CPM, CPC).

sections.title: Nice to Have
bullets: Experience with HSA/FSA, healthcare payments, or regulated purchase flows.
Experience building or scaling a two-sided marketplace.
Familiarity with tools like Optimizely, Statsig, Amplitude, or Mixpanel.

ashby:turquoise-health:f7183632-4e65-4e1.summary: This is a fully remote role within the United States.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: We are seeking a voraciously curious, systems-minded Senior/Staff Product Manager to build our Life Sciences product vertical from the ground up. This is a founding product role: you will define the strategy, ship the first products, and lay the foundation for a durable new line of business serving pharmaceutical and medical device manufacturers. You will partner closely with a dedicated GM/subject-matter expert—but as a true peer, not a student. This role requires familiarity with life sciences commercialization and manufacturer contracting —chargebacks, rebates, gross-to-net, formulary, and coverage.

Qualified candidates bring a rare mix of 0→1 product ownership in a complex industry, deep fluency in the manufacturer data and contracting landscape, an intense focus on customers and eagerness to engage with them, and the inventiveness to build something where nothing existed before. If you are a systems-thinker who thrives in ambiguity and is passionate about solving complex problems that drive economic change, we invite you to join our dynamic team.

sections.title: Why this Role Matters
paras: Turquoise has built the most comprehensive picture of negotiated rates and contract data in US healthcare. Life sciences is the next frontier: pharmaceutical and medical device manufacturers sit at the center of how drugs and devices are priced, contracted, and paid for, and bringing transparency to that economy is core to our mission to eliminate financial complexity and rebuild trust in US healthcare. This role owns that expansion end to end—what you build becomes the backbone of an entirely new business at Turquoise.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Own the 0→1: define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Life Sciences vertical, from first customer conversations through first shipped products and early revenue.
Partner with the GM/SME as a peer—co-owning the commercial motion while holding the product line and translating market access and contracting knowledge into a concrete, sequenced product plan.
Develop and defend your own domain point of view across manufacturer economics—chargebacks, rebates, gross-to-net, formulary, and coverage—and use it to make sharp prioritization calls.
Relentlessly drive early-stage concepts through iteration, execution, and enhancement, validating with real customers and making the calls that move the vertical forward under uncertainty.
Turn Turquoise's pricing and contract data assets into products that solve concrete manufacturer problems, in close partnership with Engineering and Data.
Facilitate airtight coordination across disciplines within Turquoise—Engineering, Design, GTM, and Legal—and across key external stakeholders and customers.
Be the customer's voice: build direct relationships with pharma and medical device customers and bring their reality back into the roadmap.
Continuously hone industry and subject matter expertise, staying ahead of market trends and legislative developments so Turquoise anticipates the tailwinds and headwinds in life sciences.

sections.title: What You'll Bring
bullets: 7+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning products end to end.
5+ years in health technology, with a strong grasp of how healthcare data, pricing, and payments fit together.
3+ years working with or adjacent to pharmaceutical or medical device manufacturers—you understand their commercial and contracting world from the inside.
Demonstrated ability to ship high-complexity, 0→1 solutions in a fast-paced startup environment with rapidly changing priorities.
Subject-matter credibility in your own right—you can go as deep as a GM/SME as a peer.
A clear track record of growth and increasing scope—impact and staying power, not just tenure.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and align senior stakeholders both internally and externally.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and iterating in response to internal and market feedback.

ashby:vendelux:4dc5089d-b2ce-4e87-b2e8-9.summary:

Events are one of the largest and most impactful marketing channels, yet historically one of the least measurable. Vendelux brings transparency and performance to this space — helping companies discover, evaluate, and optimize their event strategy with data.

Our platform powers thousands of event decisions by delivering proprietary, AI-driven insights across hundreds of thousands of events globally. Make sure every customer interaction ladders up to satisfaction and retention, not just ticket closure.

Experience supporting a large book of customers (hundreds of accounts) and building the processes to do it well.
A track record of implementing support systems from the ground up, such as evaluating and selecting a ticketing platform, workflows, SLAs and knowledge bases.
Hands-on experience with support platforms (e.g. Zendesk, Intercom, HubSpot Service Hub, Pylon) and CRMs (HubSpot preferred).

Comfort with SaaS products, integrations and data. You can learn a product deeply and explain it simply, without needing an engineering background.

sections.title: Why You'll Love Working Here
paras: This is a chance to build something, not just maintain it. You’ll have a direct line to CS leadership, real ownership over how support works, and the freedom to try new tools and ideas.
bullets: Join at a pivotal stage and shape a support function from the ground up.
Work on an AI-first team that treats automation as a superpower, not a buzzword.
High visibility across Customer Success, Product and leadership.
Grow with us: as the customer base scales, so does the role and the team around it.

ashby:watershed:9361e773-9d48-485a-bce7-.summary:
Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

sections.title: The role
paras: Watershed is hiring an experienced manager for one of our North American Customer Success teams! The team empowers our customers to measure, report and scale with our sustainability platform at the core. Our North American CS team has grown and we are looking for a leader who cares deeply about developing, coaching, and building a team of early career and experienced CSMs.

You and your team will help refine and scale the customer success function as we gear up for this next year+ of growth. In this role, one of your primary areas of focus will be designing and building our “scaled” approach to Customer Success. You will shape the strategy, playbooks, systems, and tools that enable our teams to deliver strong customer outcomes efficiently and consistently. This includes developing 1:many engagement programs, improving lifecycle experiences, devising AI first strategies, and partnering with other CS leaders to adapt successful approaches across teams and geographies.

You will also serve as a senior advocate for your team and customers across Watershed. You will work closely with Product, Sales, Sustainability Advisory, Support, and other cross-functional teams to help customers achieve their sustainability goals and translate customer needs into actionable improvements to our products and services

sections.title: You will:
bullets: Hire, develop and coach a team of Customer Success Managers
Develop and help drive team to achieve key metrics, including customer satisfaction, retention, and expansion

Design, build, and oversee strategy and programs for a “Scaled” Customer Success motion. Leverage AI systems and tools to drive personalized scaled experiences and targeted team engagement. Partnering with global CS managers to help them adapt this motion to new geographies.
Guide and support your team in delivering customer outcomes at scale, taking an active role in helping them drive 1:many engagement strategies with Watershed’s products and services
Partner with your team to act as a key contact with Sr level stakeholders at our customers and support their lifecycle with Watershed
Collaborate with our product teams and be the voice of the customer, providing regular and actionable customer feedback
Develop and implement processes and tools that help the CS function scale and effectively deliver value for customers
Be a representative of the CS function, and of the broader Watershed leadership team, within the San Francisco office

bullets: Minimum of 5 years of experience in a Customer Success or similar role including at least 2 years of management experience
A background and experience with Customer Success in an Enterprise SaaS space
Experience delivering and managing Scaled Customer Success programs for Mid-Market and Enterprise Customers

greenhouse:ahrefsjobs:6211637004.summary:
Ahrefs is an all-in-one marketing intelligence platform used by marketers, businesses and agencies around the world. Our tools help people understand search demand, analyse competitors, improve website performance and research content opportunities, backed by 15 years of web crawling data and increasingly powered by AI.

We’re bootstrapped and profitable, and we have been for 15 years. There are no investors and no board, which means no outside timeline on our decisions. We’re multinational, with offices in Palo Alto, Cambridge (MA), Singapore and Tokyo, and our culture is fast-moving, low-ego, and built on smart decisions and ownership.

sections.title: The role
paras: We’re looking for an Enterprise Implementation Specialist to own the technical support and implementation after an enterprise customer signs.

That’s the whole job, and it’s a big one. You’ll take a brand-new Ahrefs Enterprise account from contract to fully live: setting up the account, migrating their keyword sets across from whatever they were using before, and running the onboarding training. When something breaks or someone gets stuck, you’re who they reach. When renewal comes around, the reason they say yes is largely the work you did in the first ninety days.

You’ll work directly alongside our Account Managers. They own the account strategy and the commercial relationship: where the customer is heading and what they need. You own making it real. It’s a genuine partnership, and it only works if both halves are strong.

sections.title: What you’ll do
bullets: Run hands-on account setup for new enterprise customers, configuring projects, workspaces, permissions and integrations to match how each customer actually works.
Own keyword migrations end to end: audit what they have, map it across, move it, validate it, and make sure nothing quietly went missing.
Deliver onboarding training to customer teams, from the SEO practitioners to marketing managers.
Be the technical escalation point for your accounts: triage support requests, dig into the actual problem, resolve what you can, and drive what you can’t to the right people internally.
Turn what you learn into reusable assets (migration playbooks, training materials, documentation) so the tenth implementation is faster than the first.
Feed real customer friction back to Product.

sections.title: Must have
bullets: 3-5 years in customer support, implementation, onboarding, technical account management, or a comparable hands-on post-sale role at a SaaS company.
Direct experience taking enterprise customers live. You’ve owned a go-live, not just supported one.
Genuine comfort with data migration work: mapping, transforming, validating, and explaining to a customer why their 40,000 keywords came across as 39,847.
The ability to run a training session and have the attendees leave able to do the thing.
Real technical range: APIs, integrations, CSVs, spreadsheets at scale, and the instinct to reproduce a bug before escalating it.
Strong written and verbal communication.
The ability to figure things out independently.
AI must be a part of your daily workflow.

Hands-on time with Ahrefs, or with a competing enterprise SEO platform.
Experience with enterprise onboarding at scale.
Experience working next to an account management or CS function.

greenhouse:andurilindustries:5249218007.summary: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

sections.title: ABOUT THE TEAM
paras:
Maritime Digital Production (MDP) is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. We build the software-defined shipyard. That means the full technology stack running Anduril's shipbuilding factories: the data infrastructure that makes every machine and sensor visible in real time, ArsenalOS (our manufacturing execution system that workers and planners use every shift), the scheduling engine that replans production in minutes instead of days, and the AI systems that eliminate manual toil from both the shop floor and business operations.

This work is anchored by Arsenal-2, our software-defined shipyard being built in Baltimore County, Maryland. It's part of a new $6.6 billion investment in America's submarine industrial base. ArsenalOS is the digital backbone of that yard. It connects fabrication and outfitting to material movement and inspection. Planners get one real-time view of production. We aren't waiting for the yard to open. Development is already underway here in Orange County, California. The team is proving out the manufacturing methods and digital workflows that will scale across the shipyard network.

MDP operates at the boundary between Operational Technology and Information Technology. Our systems live where factory-floor machines, edge compute, and OT networks meet enterprise platforms and cloud infrastructure. We incubate solutions close to the production line, validate them with real operators building real hardware, harden them for reliability and security, and then scale them across multiple sites. The environment is fast, physical, and consequential. When our systems go down, production stops. The output of our work is not a dashboard: it is a ship.

This is not a support function. It is a strategic investment by Anduril in the premise that digitizing the manufacturing lifecycle end-to-end, from engineering definition through scheduling through execution through field feedback, is how Heavy Metal will out-build, out-adapt, and out-scale the traditional defense industrial base. MDP is scaling from a founding team to 70+ engineers across multiple U.S. sites. You will be joining early, working on hard problems with real operational stakes, and shaping how manufacturing software is built at Anduril from the ground up.

sections.title: ABOUT THE JOB
paras:
As a Senior Product Manager for Manufacturing Software, you will own the product strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for the factory floor applications that production operators, supervisors, and manufacturing engineers rely on every shift. You will own the deployment of these products onto the factory floor, working shoulder to shoulder with the people who build ships to make sure the software earns its place in their workflow.
Product Strategy
You can “see around the corner” for your product, crafting the vision, high-level roadmap, and critical dependencies for 6 to 12 months into the future. You constantly engage with stakeholders to solicit input and buy-in, proactively communicating product goals and managing expectations for delivery. You escalate large tradeoffs and decision points as needed. You work effectively across many internal teams to synthesize their needs, but are never afraid to make important decisions as the owner of your product.
Product Prioritization
You work backward from your strategy to set clear outcomes for your portfolio in partnership with your engineering, design, and operations partners. You support team structures that allow prioritization of competing work within rapid development cycles, and you let your team flex to adapt goals when new information arrives.
Problem Discovery and Solution Generation
You become attached to problems, not solutions. You seek out real-world context through onsite user research on the factory floor, direct conversations with technicians and operators, internal expert feedback, existing product data, and industry investigation. You separate what a customer asks for from what a customer actually needs, capture core workflows, and translate them into well-scoped requirements and success hypotheses.
Product Execution
From design to delivery, you fill gaps wherever needed to make your well-scoped solutions a reality. You proactively communicate with internal team members and stakeholders, approach solutions with humility and creativity to hit milestones, and set a high bar for the product you own, including how it is deployed, adopted, and supported on the floor.

sections.title: WHAT YOU'LL DO
bullets: Developing a long-term strategy that navigates complex product tradeoffs, integration dependencies, and buy versus build decisions to push the manufacturing software domain forward
Gathering and refining both functional requirements and non-functional requirements such as tool capacity, performance, and reliability, and synthesizing them into a prioritized backlog

Communicating across stakeholders and interested parties on roadmap and delivery, and exercising the judgment to tell whether a stakeholder truly needs what they are asking for or whether the underlying problem is better solved another way
Walking the factory floor, talking directly with technicians and operators about how their work is going, and turning what you hear into opportunities to fix and improve the product

Navigating the organizational dynamics between Maritime Digital Production and partner platform teams, advocating from the customer point of view when Maritime's needs differ from how a platform team would prefer to build
Exploring and incorporating technologies that enhance Anduril's operational leverage
Driving adoption and enablement of manufacturing software across production and operations teams

SAMs will be responsible for product performance at a territory level and expected to be a disease state expert, product champion and an account specialist. The SAM will provide account management support and exhibit business knowledge of the local landscape to assess key stakeholders plus future trends within the marketplace.

sections.title: Job Responsibilities and Duties include, but are not limited to, the following:
bullets: Drive product adoption in LTC facilities
Proficient in both virtual and live customer engagements

Effectively call on LTC Care teams, building meaningful relationships across the entire LTC ecosystem: Psychiatrists, Neurologists, nurse practitioners, Physician assistants, Nurses and LTC staff, Closed-door pharmacies, clinical pharmacists, case managers and care coordinators.

Develop a comprehensive and effective territory business plan inclusive of account plans for targeted LTC facilities aimed at achieving and exceeding quarterly & annual goals established by commercial leadership
Promote within our approved labeling in a comprehensive, fair, and ethical manner that is consistent with industry specific and corporate legal and regulatory guidelines
Develop strong customer relationships by better understanding the customer’s needs
Serve as a resource/consultant to customers and staff regarding payer policies and processes (i.e., eligibility and benefit verification, prior-authorization, and appeals/denials)
Navigate Market Access and Reimbursement. LTC SAMs must understand: payer requirements, pharmacy fulfillment processes, patient access programs, reimbursement tools such as cover my meds

sections.title: Qualifications / Requirements
bullets: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university
Minimum of 5 years of pharmaceutical/biotech sales experience, including 2+ years in LTC or account-based selling environments
Demonstrated experience delivering outstanding results, including Top 10% or Elite/President’s Club performance
Launch experience strongly preferred
Must live within the geography of the assigned territory
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, utilizing differential resources to achieve business goals
Proven ability to successfully manage multiple tasks concurrently under accelerated timelines in a dynamic environment
Ability to thrive with ambiguity and business environments with high expectations

greenhouse:betterhelpcom:5471813008.summary:
BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As the Principal Product Manager, Network Economics at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our…

sections.title: What are we looking for?
paras: BetterHelp is looking for a principal-level individual contributor to own therapist compensation and incentives: the economic mechanisms that determine whether a client who needs care can find the right therapist, in their state, under their plan, as soon as possible. We match hundreds of thousands of clients to licensed therapists across every state and a growing set of insurance plans. How quickly that match happens comes down to the strength, size, and variety of our therapist population, and how quickly we can shift it toward the plans and states where clients are waiting.

This individual will own the mechanisms that drive that supply pool, compensation rates, structure, and incentives, as a product and be accountable for the business outcome, not just the shipped feature. That means close collaboration with cross functional stakeholders, deriving defensible answers to how much therapist capacity we actually need and where, and experiments that tell us how the network responds when we change what it earns.

It’s an exciting opportunity for someone who is deeply analytical and does their best work in ambiguity: able to take a problem where the data is incomplete and the stakeholders don’t yet agree, and still reach an effective outcome with the organization behind it. The problems here sit where product, economics, and clinical operations meet, all while making a difference in the lives of people seeking mental health care.

sections.title: What will you do?
bullets: Own the incentive system that moves therapist availability toward where clients actually need it, designed to be targeted, measurable, and reversible
Own the structure and clarity of the compensation model itself: what a therapist can predict about their earnings, and what the model rewards them for
Define what “well supplied” means for a network like ours, and build the tools and features that close the gap

Build a compelling and sustainable earnings proposition for therapists, and use controlled rollouts and rigorous measurement to learn what actually moves availability before we commit to it, all within the realities of a licensed, independent clinical workforce
Incentivize the specific behaviors that create client access, including therapist availability, match acceptance, and continuity of care
Analyze and quantify the impact of every change we make, then draw conclusions and plan next steps based on actual data
Partner closely with matching, eligibility, member experience, therapist experience, and provider acquisition. Your systems and theirs depend on each other

Work cross-functionally with finance, clinical, legal, marketing, data science, and operations, who have a stake in nearly everything this role touches, to get a change designed, approved, launched, and measured

sections.title: What will you NOT do?
bullets: You will NOT worry about "runway", "cash left", or "how much time we have until the next round". We have the startup DNA but we're fully backed and funded, all the way to success.
You will NOT be confined to your "job". You will get involved in product, marketing, business strategy, and almost everything we do.
You will NOT be bogged down by office politics, ego, or bad attitude. Only positive, pleasure-to-work-with people are allowed here!
You will NOT get yourself burned out. We work hard but we believe in maintaining a sustainable work/life balance. Really.

sections.title: Requirements
bullets: 8-10 years experience in a product role with proven success through measurable impact and increasing responsibilities, including experience owning pricing, incentives, payouts, or supply-side economics in a two-sided marketplace
Super analytical: you can build the model, defend it in a room with data science, and explain it to a CFO without losing either audience
Deep understanding of unit and business economics, and a proven ability to balance business, clinical, and technical considerations in a product decision
You know which decisions to test cheaply and which ones you only get to make once, and you can tell the difference under time pressure
Strong understanding of marketplace dynamics and two-sided marketplace business models
Sound judgment in ambiguity. You can tell when the evidence is good enough to act on and when the right move is to dig deeper, and you can explain which call you’re making and why
A track record of driving cross-functional decisions to a conclusion without authority over the people who have to agree
Excellent written communication. Much of this role is making a quantitative argument that an executive audience can act on

This is a commercially minded role for someone who can translate a sophisticated supply chain and revenue platform into clear, differentiated value for the specific people who buy and champion it: supply…

sections.title: The Opportunity
paras: You will define our solution positioning, build the value proposition and ROI narrative, arm our Commercial team with the tools to win, and turn customer outcomes into evidence the market believes. You'll partner closely with Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership — leading through influence to ensure that what we say in the market and what we deliver in the OR are one and the same.

sections.title: About You
bullets: You balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, equally comfortable shaping a positioning strategy and writing the deck that brings it to life.
You are a strong storyteller who can make a complex, multi-stakeholder solution feel obvious and urgent to a CFO, a perioperative director, and a value analysis committee alike.
You think commercially. You connect product capability to measurable business outcomes: cost avoided, revenue captured, hours returned to clinical teams.
You thrive in a fast-paced, start-up environment and are energized by ambiguity, white space, and building from a strong but unfinished foundation.
You lead through influence, earning trust and alignment across Leadership, Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Marketing without relying on positional authority.
You bring deep healthcare context, ideally in supply chain, the OR, implant management, revenue cycle, medical devices, or value analysis. And you understand how hospitals actually buy.
You have exceptional interpersonal skills and build strong relationships with customers, colleagues, and stakeholders.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Own the positioning and messaging architecture for Casechek's solutions, ensuring a consistent, differentiated narrative across the buyer journey.
Develop and maintain messaging guides and solution playbooks that define the features, benefits, and quantifiable value of our solutions, guiding the creation of all client-facing assets.

Build and continually sharpen buyer personas across the full hospital buying committee, and develop messaging tailored to each: Supply Chain leaders, Perioperative leaders, Finance executives, Revenue Cycle leaders, Value Analysis committees, and Hospital executives.
Map persona priorities and objections to the moments in the sales cycle where they matter most.
Create the value proposition and economic story for our solutions, grounded in real account outcomes around cost, revenue, and operational efficiency.
Develop ROI models, value assessments, and business cases that arm Sales and Customer Success to quantify impact and justify investment to executive buyers.
Develop and own go-to-market and commercialization plans for new and existing solutions, ensuring continued growth and clean handoffs across Product, Sales, and Customer Success.
Partner on solution packaging and pricing narrative so that what we sell is easy to understand and easy to buy.

More than 22M people living with cancer have behavioral health needs such as anxiety, depression, and distress. We integrate with oncology practices and health systems through the Collaborative Care Model (CoCM) to wrap our members with a behavioral health team, care programming, and outcomes analysis.

The Collaborative Care Model is an evidence-based clinical model that has been shown to successfully improve mild to moderate behavioral health needs more effectively than the current standard of care. With program customized to our members, we will…

sections.title: Why Choose Cerula Care
paras: We understand choosing a place to work or consult is a really important decision, and we want you to know that we do not take it lightly on your behalf – we welcome all your questions as you go through the decision process! Here is what you should know about our core values as you consider applying.
Behavioral Health Care Manager + Provider Success role:
bullets: Outcomes Focused. We are here to change lives, not to stay busy. Every project, meeting, and decision is measured against whether it meaningfully improves outcomes — for our patients, our partners, and our business. This means saying no to things that don't move the needle and holding ourselves accountable to the metrics that matter.

sections.title: The Role
paras: The Behavioral Health Care Manager + Provider Success professional is a core member of Cerula Care’s collaborative care team. This is a full-time, Colorado-based role designed to test and build the value of an on-the-ground presence with our oncology partner.

The role is approximately 50% behavioral health care management and 50% provider success and sales support. The successful candidate will deliver high-quality, relationship-centered care to patients while building trusted, productive relationships with oncology providers, nurses, advanced practice providers, and practice teams across oncology practice locations.

This person will work remotely for core clinical and administrative responsibilities while traveling regularly to oncology offices throughout Colorado for site launches, in-person trainings, provider and clinical team visits, and ongoing relationship development.

sections.title: Clinical Care Management (approximately 50%)
bullets: Conduct initial biopsychosocial intakes, including safety screening and behavioral health assessments such as the PHQ-9 and GAD-7.

Provide follow-up visits and asynchronous support using brief, evidence-based interventions, including Behavioral Activation, Motivational Interviewing, mindfulness, psychoeducation, and coping skills development.
Build strong, trusted relationships with patients and engage them effectively through telehealth and, when appropriate, in-person interactions.
Support patients in identifying barriers to care, increasing engagement, building self-management skills, and implementing behavioral health treatment recommendations.

Lead weekly interdisciplinary case review meetings with the Consulting Psychiatrist and relevant care team members, ensuring high-risk members are discussed and psychiatric recommendations are documented.
Coordinate closely with Cerula Care’s behavioral health team, including the Consulting Psychiatrist, coaches, patient engagement team, and operational partners.
Document member progress accurately and promptly in Cerula Care’s HIPAA-compliant electronic medical record and client registry.
Identify patients who are not improving or may need a higher level of mental health care, and communicate concerns to the medical provider and Consulting Psychiatrist.

sections.title: Provider Success and Field Engagement (approximately 50%)
bullets: Manage initial customer implementation within Cerula Care and with practice stakeholders
Serve as a visible, trusted Cerula Care partner to providers and practice teams in and around Denver and Colorado Springs areas.
Attend site launches and provide in-person training and education for providers, nurses, advanced practice providers, and office teams.
Build excellent provider relationships through consistent follow-up, responsiveness, and a strong understanding of each site’s workflow and referral needs.
Help providers and staff understand Cerula Care’s services, appropriate patient populations, referral pathways, and the role of the BHCM within the Collaborative Care Model.
Act as a liaison between referring specialists, practice teams, patients, and Cerula Care, ensuring clinical and administrative questions are answered or routed promptly.
Partner with Cerula Care’s commercial and customer success leaders to support referral engagement, identify barriers and opportunities, and strengthen adoption across practice sites.
Gather and communicate field feedback to improve launch execution, training, provider experience, patient experience, and referral workflows.

greenhouse:chainguard:4727027006.summary:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

sections.title: The role, in a nutshell:
paras: As Senior Manager, Renewals at Chainguard, you will build and lead the team responsible for renewing our customer base across Commercial, Enterprise, and Public Sector. You will own the global renewal number, set the strategy and operating rhythm for the function, and develop a team of Renewal Managers who deliver predictable, on-time renewals and strong gross retention.

This role sits at the intersection of Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and Ops. You will define how renewals are owned and handed off across CSMs, AEs, and Renewal Managers, partner with RevOps on forecasting and systems, and give leadership a clear, accurate view of renewal health and risk every week, while supporting Chainguard’s broader revenue and retention goals.

You will be the leader and builder of the renewal function. Chainguard’s renewal team is still early, so you will define its structure, hire and develop its managers and Renewal Managers, and scale it across segments and regions as the business grows. Strong leadership, sound commercial judgment, and the ability to bring structure to a fast-changing environment are essential.

sections.title: What you’ll do:
bullets: Team Leadership: Build and lead the global renewals organization across Commercial, Enterprise, and Public Sector, including hiring and developing team leads as the function grows, and setting clear books of business, expectations, and performance goals.
Renewal Ownership: Own the global renewal forecast and gross retention targets, and serve as the executive escalation point for the highest-value and most at-risk renewals.
Commercial Strategy: Set renewal pricing, discounting, uplift, and multi-year guidelines with Finance and Deal Desk, and drive policies such as co-terming add-ons with renewals.
Forecasting & Reporting: Run a weekly renewal forecast cadence, hold the team to high CRM and forecasting standards, and report renewal health, risk, and churn trends to CS and revenue leadership.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Define clear ownership and handoffs between Renewal Managers, CSMs, and AEs, and partner with RevOps on territories, capacity, compensation, and systems.
Risk & Retention Strategy: Build early warning processes with Customer Success to surface risk 120+ days out, and lead save plans on critical accounts.
Process & Playbooks: Build segment-specific renewal playbooks, including public sector fiscal year planning and enterprise executive engagement, and continuously improve on-time renewal rates.

sections.title: What we're looking for:
paras: If your experience is close, but doesn’t fulfill all requirements, please apply . Chainguard is on a mission to build the best team. To achieve our goal, we are focused on hiring Chainguardians with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.
bullets: 8+ years of experience in B2B SaaS renewals, account management, or customer success, including 4+ years leading renewal or account management teams, ideally with experience managing managers.
Proven ownership of a renewal or retention number, with a track record of improving gross retention and forecast accuracy.
Experience leading renewals across multiple segments, ideally including enterprise and public sector.
Strong commercial judgment, with experience setting pricing, discounting, and contract policy with Finance and Deal Desk.
Experience building renewal processes, playbooks, and reporting from the ground up in a scaling organization.
Deep familiarity with Salesforce and forecasting tools such as Clari.
Ability to influence and align senior stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Ops.
High emotional intelligence, strong communication skills, and a proactive, problem-solving mindset.

sections.title: What You’ll Do

Observability Platform brings logs, traces, analytics, alerts, and dashboards together in one place, so customers can see what's happening and why. greenhouse:endorlabs:4748580005.summary:
AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.

The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.

AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and…
