In this role, you will directly contribute to transforming how Omada uses data to serve members, customers and internal stakeholders. Your work will:

You will immerse yourself in how teams across Omada learn, make decisions and use data to improve member experiences. Your impact will touch Product, Clinical, Commercial, Operations, Finance and more.
bullets: Establishing and maintaining authoritative definitions for core business and clinical concepts and resolving conflicts between local and enterprise views
Designing and evolving governance processes, SOPs and engagement models so analysts and business users can work efficiently within a coherent, well-understood framework
Managing the lifecycle of governed metrics and definitions, including ownership, review, certification, versioning and retirement
Keeping business glossary and data catalog content current, including owners, lineage and quality status, so data assets are easy to find and understand

Defining and maintaining Omada’s data ontology: the core business and clinical entities (such as member, program, enrollment, engagement, client and outcome), their attributes and how they relate to one another
Translating approved definitions into semantic layer requirements for metrics, dimensions, joins, time grains and approved breakdowns, and partnering with Data Engineering to implement them
Establishing shared dimensions so a concept is reported the same way across dashboards, models and AI-assisted tools
Writing acceptance criteria and test cases that confirm semantic layer outputs match governed definitions before release

greenhouse:osano:5485380008.summary: Osano is an innovative B-Corporation built around a simple belief: privacy is a fundamental right. Since day one, we’ve been focused on giving modern enterprises the ability to innovate quickly, stay competitive, and earn customer trust by respecting data privacy and complying with consent guidelines. Our products help organizations operate confidently in a rapidly evolving regulatory and technological landscape.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Osano is hiring a Customer Success Manager who thrives at the intersection of customer relationships and commercial growth. In this hybrid role, you’ll be responsible for not only ensuring our customers succeed with Osano’s privacy platform, but also for driving retention and expansion within your portfolio. You’ll act as both trusted advisor and strategic account owner, helping customers realize ongoing value, while leading the commercial conversations that fuel their long-term partnership with Osano.

We’re looking for someone who blends relationship management with account growth expertise. You’ll own a book of business, build outcome-based success plans, lead QBRs, and manage renewals and expansions from start to finish. This is a high-impact role at a mission-driven, venture-backed Series B startup working at the forefront of data privacy, trust, and innovation.

At Osano, we value candidates from all walks of life and are focused on building a diverse team. If you don't exactly meet all the listed requirements, don't let that keep you from applying. We're looking for people who are eager to learn and grow with us. If you're interested in being part of our inclusive, mission-driven, venture-backed tech startup, say hi!

sections.title: The Role
bullets: Own a portfolio of customer accounts , building long-term, trusted relationships that deliver satisfaction, retention, and measurable revenue growth.

Drive renewals and expansions, owning commercial responsibility for your book of business, leading renewal negotiations and uncovering expansion opportunities across use cases, personas, and business units.

Develop strategic account plans through stakeholder mapping, aligning on outcomes, and leading regular business reviews that both demonstrate ROI and identify new opportunities for adoption and upsell.
Guide the post-implementation journey, partnering with Implementation Managers for seamless handoffs and proactively driving product adoption, feature activation, and value realization.
Monitor account health by leveraging product data, engagement signals, and customer feedback to flag risks early, mitigate churn, and strengthen customer commitment.
Operate cross-functionally, by partnering with Sales, Product, Support, and Engineering to advocate for your customers and shape both the product and the customer experience.

Be a commercial and strategic point of contact, known for sharp account insights, confident commercial conversations, and the ability to create moments that build executive trust and customer loyalty.
Document insights and patterns, contributing to the CSM playbook by sharing what drives renewals, expansions, and customer success at scale.

sections.title: About You
bullets: 2+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a hybrid CSM/AM role at a B2B SaaS company (startup/high-growth experience preferred).
Proven success managing a book of business with commercial accountability, including leading renewals, negotiating contracts, and owning expansion targets.
A track record of driving expansion revenue through upsell, cross-sell, and usage-based growth. You spot whitespace in an account and know how to turn it into a closed deal.
Skilled at balancing strategic relationship management with commercial execution. You know how to build trust with senior stakeholders, driving outcomes that grow revenue.
Experience and enthusiasm for creating and leading QBRs, success plans, and executive conversations that highlight ROI and identify new opportunities.
You’re curious and capable with complex subject matter, and are comfortable learning SaaS products, privacy/compliance concepts, and technical integrations.
Data-driven with experience using CRM and CSM tools (HubSpot, Vitally, etc.) and product usage analytics to guide strategy and surface opportunities.
Strong communicator. You’re clear, confident, and persuasive across email, meetings, and presentations.

sections.title: A Bit More About Osano
paras: Osano is a leading data privacy platform that helps organizations quickly and confidently comply with laws like GDPR, CCPA, and other global privacy regulations. From consent management to vendor risk monitoring, Osano makes complex privacy tasks refreshingly simple, so companies can focus on what they do best, while we handle the rest.

We’re backed by top-tier investors including Baird Capital, Jump Capital, and LiveOak, and we’re scaling fast with a multi-year runway and ambitious growth plans. We’ve also been recognized as a Great Place to Work for four years running, with 97% of employees saying Osano is a great place to work.

As we grow, we're looking for individuals who lean into modern technologies and smarter systems to drive efficiency, clarity, and speed; both in our product and in how we operate. If you're excited by the idea of helping build a high-growth, privacy-first company that embraces thoughtful automation, emerging tech, and intentional collaboration, we’d love to hear from you.

greenhouse:pallet:5307647007.summary:
Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy, a $12 trillion global TAM. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures.

Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, and control.

As companies across the physical economy look to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.

sections.title: About Pallet
paras: Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.

sections.title: About the opportunity:
paras: We’re hiring a Sales Engineer— a hybrid technical and customer-facing role that connects our AI platform to the real workflows of the world’s largest logistics companies.

You’ll own technical validation and custom demos, work directly with Sales, Product, and Engineering, and drive proofs of concept that show customers what’s possible when AI meets logistics. This is a founding role with the opportunity to build the playbook and eventually scale the Sales Engineering org.

sections.title: Why this role is different:
bullets: Founding member of the Sales Engineering team — help shape process, tooling, and best practices.
Combines hands-on integration and workflow design with storytelling and customer credibility.
Work directly with executives and customers across the enterprise logistics ecosystem.
Learn deeply about AI agent architecture (browser automation, voice AI, RAG/memory systems).

sections.title: How you will make an impact:
bullets: Own and deliver technical demos that accelerate deals — translate real customer workflows into high-impact, tailored experiences.
Build quick integrations and prototypes using Zapier, Retool, or Make to demonstrate value fast.
Map and reason through data flows across TMS, WMS, and CRM systems — understanding APIs, schemas, and webhooks.
Partner with Sales on proofs of concept and technical validation throughout the deal cycle.
Communicate clearly across audiences — from operations leads to CTOs, adapting depth and framing as needed.
Enable the GTM team — build demo templates, run feature briefings, and improve internal technical fluency.
Feed insights back to Product — capture workflow pain points and feature requests from the field to shape roadmap direction.

greenhouse:prenuvo:4755837005.summary:
At Prenuvo , we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

Reporting to the Director of Product Marketing, the Senior Product Marketing Manager will lead Prenuvo's most important product marketing initiatives and oversee our global product launches. This role is responsible for bringing discipline & rigor to how we bring products to market: defining who each product is for, how it's positioned, priced, packaged, launches and grows.

sections.title: Lead product launches
bullets: Oversee global product launches end to end, from audience definition and positioning through launch readiness and post-launch review.
Orchestrate Product, Growth, Brand, Creative, Lifecycle, Comms, Clinical and Sales around one plan, with scope, timelines and success metrics set before launch.
Build a repeatable launch engine: the playbooks, templates and review workflows the team will scale on, with medical and legal review built in from the start.

sections.title: Shape what we build
bullets: Be the voice of the customer in product ideation and roadmap decisions, shaping what we build and for whom.
Use qualitative and quantitative insight and customer data to shape positioning, pricing and packaging to inform product launches and drive cross-sell and retention.
Plan and run research with Consumer Insights, UX and external agency partners, and turn segmentation, interviews, surveys, funnel data and competitive analysis into specific recommendations.

sections.title: Own messaging and positioning
bullets: Define who each offering is for, the need it meets and why Prenuvo is the right choice.
Build and maintain the messaging framework that serves as our single source of truth for positioning, claims and proof points across every product and channel.

Balance scientific and medical accuracy with consumer clarity: translate clinical and technical depth into benefits people understand and act on, partnering with Medical and Legal so every claim is substantiated.

sections.title: Drive growth and retention
bullets: Partner with Product, Growth, Lifecycle and Analytics to drive trial, adoption, retention and renewal after launch.
Champion a culture of experimentation: form hypotheses, run tests and use results to sharpen messaging, audiences, use cases and offers.
Work with Data Science on the dashboards that show how each launch is performing and inform what we do next.

greenhouse:recast:5409366008.summary:
Recast helps the sharpest teams in the world solve complex measurement problems with best-in-class, composable marketing mix models and tooling. Years of marketing science research, proprietary modeling technology, and an exceptional delivery team are why brands like Hasbro, Canva, and Block trust us with their burning business decisions.

Now we’re hiring a Head of Product to make the experience of using Recast as powerful as the science behind it. You’ll build the product function, own our product vision and strategy, and lead and develop the team. Reporting directly to Recast’s CEO, you’ll join our senior leadership team alongside the heads of Engineering, Revenue, Marketing and Data Science.

sections.title: What you'll do
bullets: Set the product vision and strategy. Own the near-term execution and long-term vision across our app, API, and MCP surfaces. Write the narratives that show how a product experience will move the needle for customers and for Recast.
Build the product function. Stand up how product works here: discovery-to-delivery loops, explicit and fast prioritization, and a shared view of what we’re building and why.
Lead and shape the team. Manage and develop our current product manager and own the product team's structure, roles, and ways of working as we grow.
Make customer discovery a standing practice. Spend real time with customers, watch them work, and build an evidence-based view of who they are and what they're trying to get done.
Define success and measure it. Set the product metrics and feedback loops that show us what's working, and decide what we do when something isn't.

Turn what we ship into what customers achieve. Partner closely with engineering, delivery, and go-to-market so that every launch has a compelling story, a path to adoption, and a clear read on its impact.
Productize research breakthroughs. Work with our research team to turn new modeling developments into products customers can use and pay for.

sections.title: What we're looking for
bullets: A 0-to-1 builder. You've built a product function from the ground up, and you've managed PMs along the way. You're as comfortable doing the work yourself as you are growing the people around you.
A natural at discovery. You're at your best talking to technical, data-savvy users, and you turn what you hear into a clear, evidence-backed point of view.

Technical fluency, not technical depth. You're comfortable using an API and MCP tools yourself, because you'll be defining their user experience, but you don't need to be an engineer or a data scientist. You'll complement a deeply technical, research-led team.
Org-wide strategic thinker. You’ll become a member of Recast’s senior leadership team and inform our company-wide positioning and market direction.

An excellent writer and future thinker. Clear narratives are how strategy gets executed at Recast. We need someone who’s thinking about where enterprise product experiences are going and changing, and can clearly articulate how Recast will get there first.

sections.title: What makes you stand out
bullets: A feel for how marketing budgets get set, defended, and argued for (and against)
Background in API-first or AI-native products
Experience with products that serve multiple enterprise stakeholders concurrently

sections.title: Things that should excite you that might scare off other folks
bullets: A blank page. There's no inherited playbook, roadmap process, or org chart - you’ll get to write them.
Leaders here do the work. You'll write the narratives, sketch the prototypes, and join customer calls yourself.
Building for users who may never open a UI. You'll define great product experience for customers who increasingly work only through APIs and AI agents, not just an app.

Making calls without certainty. AI is reshaping this space fast, and waiting for perfect information means missing the moment. You're comfortable deciding with good-enough evidence and adjusting as you learn.
A remote, async-first team. Recast is spread globally across time zones, and clear written communication is essential here.

greenhouse:recordedfuture:8859086002.summary:
With 1,000+ intelligence professionals serving over 1,900 clients worldwide, Recorded Future is the world’s most advanced, and largest, intelligence company!

Recorded Future is seeking an emerging intelligence or cybersecurity professional eager to learn and grow at the intersection of technology, threat intelligence, and customer success. As an Associate Technical Account Manager , you are a proactive learner who follows standard practices. sections.title: What You’ll Do
paras: This role focuses on learning foundational customer success processes and supporting a segment of accounts under detailed instruction.
bullets: Support the Customer’s Primary Technical Use Cases/Needs
Support a portfolio of customer accounts for realizing value from Recorded Future’s products and services, as guided by a TAM/Senior TAM

greenhouse:samsara:8281716.summary: Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

sections.title: About the role:
paras: As a Samsara Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will build a track record of customer success by leveraging your technical expertise, strong business acumen, proficiency in English, and a commitment to living by Samsara's core values and operating principles. Your primary responsibilities will be to build and maintain relationships with customers and account teams, develop a technical understanding of your customers’ Samsara implementations, transform their technical support experience, update our system of engagement, and contribute to team growth. These activities will enable you to proactively set your assigned customers up for success by optimizing their Samsara platform and mitigating risk with particular care during critical peak events.

As a TAM, you will occasionally be the point of contact for significant incidents, being responsible for the customer’s expectations and communications through resolving such incidents. Our TAM is the primary technical interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across internal and external stakeholders, as required, to address customer needs.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:
bullets: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

sections.title: In this role, you will:
bullets: Transform your assigned customers’ support experience through technical proficiency and problem solving. Demonstrate an understanding of Samsara's products, including APIs, hardware, and software troubleshooting.
Act as the primary technical point of contact between Samsara and assigned customers, ensuring their technical requirements and objectives are met.

Develop a comprehensive understanding of our customers' business operations and use this knowledge to align Samsara's solutions with their specific needs. Identify opportunities for additional value and growth while presenting outcomes achieved.

Cultivate solid and long-lasting relationships with technical stakeholders within your customers’ organizations. Establish yourself as a technical trusted advisor, advocating for customer interests within Samsara.
Be fluent in English to effectively engage and communicate with a diverse customer base in North America.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of customer interactions and activities in our system of engagement.
Actively participate in scaling and building the Technical Account Management team, sharing knowledge and best practices to enhance the team's capabilities.
Be available for occasional travel to customer sites and may need to be online for some after-hour or weekend coverage depending on the customers’ needs.

sections.title: Minimum requirements for the role:
paras: 7+ years of experience in technical account management, customer success, or a similar role.
bullets: Fluency in English is a must.

We welcome applications from candidates with a bachelor's degree in a technical field, or those who have gained equivalent expertise through practical experience in areas such as Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.
Exceptional technical literacy, with the ability to understand and troubleshoot hardware, software and AI technology.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain customer relationships.
Business acumen with a focus on understanding customer needs through a data-informed approach.
Strong bias for action, ownership, ability to dive deep, and insistence on the highest standards.

bullets: Python coding skills, allowing you to provide enhanced technical support and solutions to our customers.
Experience supporting enterprise-level customers in a SaaS, IoT, or PaaS environment.
Organized, with a commitment to maintaining accurate account records.
A team player who can collaborate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Prior experience with Salesforce, Zendesk, Jira, Gainsight, Tableau, and AI (Gemini preferred).

greenhouse:scopely:5375411008.summary:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Associate Product Marketing Manager to join our Monopoly GO! Game in Culver City on a hybrid basis, working 2 days a week from the hub.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

Monopoly GO! is a worldwide phenomenon, reaching tens of millions of players worldwide. This role is an opportunity to be part of a world-class team of marketers leading promotional efforts for a multi-billion-dollar game. The team is based in Canada, Europe and the US, and works every day to create captivating new experiences for our players.

sections.title: What You Will Do
bullets: Support GTM planning and campaign execution across seasonal content, in-game events, new product features, and major IP collaboration launches, partnering with Product, LiveOps, UA, CRM, Community, and other cross-functional teams to keep launches on track and unblock execution.

Drive creative development for marketing campaigns, including trailers, key art, User Acquisition creatives, and other promotional assets. Act as the primary point of contact between internal creative teams, external agencies, and marketing stakeholders to manage timelines, feedback, approvals, and asset delivery.
Support app stores promotional initiatives, including featuring opportunities, in-app event cards,co-marketing campaigns across App Store and Google Play.

Support major IP collaborations, partnering closely with external licensors and internal stakeholders throughout campaign development. Serve as the primary point of contact for licensor reviews, approvals, and day-to-day communications to ensure assets meet partner guidelines and deadlines.
Become an expert in MONOPOLY GO!, its roadmap, and live operations, using deep product knowledge to support marketing initiatives, partnership opportunities, and cross-functional decision making.

sections.title: What We’re Looking For
paras: At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

For candidates in CA, CO, NJ, NY, and WA, the annual salary range is provided below. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for equity, bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package, including healthcare benefits, retirement benefits, pet insurance, paid holidays, paid Scopely free days, and unlimited paid time off. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
bullets: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Advertising, or a related field.
Minimum 3 years of experience in product marketing, brand marketing, project management, or a similar role.
Passion for games and a strong desire to learn product marketing in a live-service environment.
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.
A proactive, self-starter mindset with strong attention to detail and a willingness to take ownership of projects from planning through execution.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience collaborating across cross-functional teams and external partners.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and adapt as priorities shift.
Experience supporting creative development, marketing campaigns, or go-to-market initiatives is a plus.

sections.title: About Scopely
paras: Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

greenhouse:shopltk:8035496003.summary:
LTK’s mission is to empower the world’s premium lifestyle Creators to achieve maximum economic success. We have a huge opportunity ahead of us and we’re looking for team members who want to create, innovate and disrupt an industry.

We empower our team members to drive innovation, create value, and continue to spearhead the creation of this industry — a game changer when it comes to career growth.

Position Title : Principal Product Manager, Creator

sections.title: About the role
paras: LTK is the industry-leading creator commerce platform, empowering creators to turn their influence into thriving businesses. We've helped establish and shape the creator economy, and now we're looking for a bold product leader to help define what's next.

As our Principal Product Manager, Creator, you'll have the opportunity to reimagine how creators discover opportunity, create shoppable content, and grow their businesses. You'll lead the strategy and evolution for Creators’ core workflows and how LTK engages, retains, and helps thousands of Creators around the world become as economically successful as possible..

This is a high-impact, senior individual contributor role for an AI-native product leader who thrives on solving complex challenges and turning ambitious ideas into reality. Working across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and Creator Success teams, you'll help shape the next generation of creator commerce and build experiences that make a meaningful difference for creators.

sections.title: How you will make an impact
bullets: Shape the future of creator commerce by defining the long-term vision and multi-quarter product strategy for the Creator Experience, shaping how creators discover opportunities, connect with Brands, and turn their inspiration and influence into shoppable content.

Build experiences that Creators love by reimagining the creator experience for the AI era, identifying opportunities to simplify workflows, remove friction, and create differentiated products that help creators grow their businesses.
Bring an AI-native approach to product innovation, exploring how AI/ML can transform and expand Creator influence, helping to make LTK Creators as economically successful as possible.
Turn deep Creator understanding, behavioral data, and experimentation into product improvements that drive engagement, retention, Creator earnings, and overall experience quality.

Define and monitor outcome measures across experience quality, creator engagement and retention, and creator earnings. Establish baselines, make trade-offs explicit, and use results to guide investment and iteration.
Bring Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and Creator Success teams together around a compelling vision, navigating complex trade-offs and driving execution across interconnected product areas.
Stay close to the customer, applying both passion and proven, AI-native frameworks for learning quickly from real user signals.
Serve as a senior product thought partner, challenging assumptions, elevating product thinking, and helping teams make better decisions that advance LTK's creator experience.

sections.title: What you will bring to LTK
bullets: 8+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of complex product areas, multi-quarter product strategy, and demonstrated influence on product direction and business outcomes across multiple teams.
Preferred: Experience with e-commerce, creator platforms, marketplaces, recommendations or Product discovery
Proven experience shaping product vision and strategy for consumer-facing products or complex platforms at scale, with a track record of delivering meaningful customer and business impact.

Hands-on experience shipping and improving AI-powered products, including personally writing evaluations (evals): developing realistic test cases, defining quality criteria and scoring rubrics, and using failure analysis to guide iteration and launch decisions.

Experience independently building functional prototypes using AI tools to make ideas tangible, test assumptions with customers, and inform product and engineering decisions before investing in full development.

An established practice of using AI in day-to-day product work, from synthesizing customer research and analyzing data to prototyping and running experiments, with strong judgment about how to validate outputs and where human expertise matters.
Strong product judgment, with the ability to translate customer needs into differentiated experiences while balancing technical complexity, business priorities, and long-term investments.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives, influence strategic product and investment decisions, and build alignment with senior leaders without direct authority.

sections.title: About LTK
paras: Founded in 2011, LTK is the global technology platform purpose-built to empower lifestyle creators to monetize their content. The full-service platform connects brands, creators, and shoppers with a world-class shopping app and trusted tools and technology that make content instantly shoppable. greenhouse:viamrobotics:6267231004.summary: Viam is the harness for physical AI. Models are getting better fast, but a model alone can’t run a robot. Before a robotics application can scale, it needs infrastructure for development, deployment, and operations. Viam provides all three, on any hardware. Developers write in Python, Go, or TypeScript and use whichever agent they already work with. They can start with one robot in simulation and grow to a production fleet without rewriting their code. Your agent writes the code, and the harness covers the rest. Viam was founded by Eliot Horowitz, co-founder of MongoDB, and is based in New York.

sections.title: The role
paras: This is a product marketing role for someone who can build. Our users are software engineers and developers, and they can tell right away when marketing doesn’t understand the product. You’ll understand it well enough to demo it, write the tutorial, answer the hard question on a webinar, and explain why our architecture choices matter to the person evaluating us.
You’ll own how developers learn what Viam does, why it works the way it does, and why that matters to them. That means fewer slide decks and more working examples.

sections.title: What you’ll do
bullets: Bring developer evidence into product decisions. Work with product leadership on what ships, how it’s packaged, and how it’s presented to developers. Back up your input with usage data, win/loss conversations, competitive research, and what you hear in the forum.

Explain the product. Turn platform capabilities like fragments, OTA updates, the Module Registry, and data and ML pipelines into clear narratives, docs-adjacent content, and demos that engineers trust.
Run technical programs end to end. Produce partner webinars and workshops: shape the story, build or coordinate the demo, prep the speakers, and handle the follow-up.

Make security legible. Work with engineering to document Viam’s security architecture (auth, network model, data handling, fleet access) so security reviewers and technical buyers get straight answers without a sales call.

Position and package our free developer courses. Work with technical content engineers on how each course is positioned, described, and promoted, so developers see right away what they’ll build. Extend that into SEO and AEO content, social, and nurture that gets registrants to their first working robot.
Own launches. Write messaging, launch briefs, and enablement for new features. Make sure sales, solutions, and community teams can explain each feature correctly.

Stay close to developers. Use the product every week. Read and contribute to our community forum and the developer groups where robotics builders spend time, and bring what you learn there back to product and marketing.

At LinkedIn, our mission is to connect the world’s professionals to make them more productive and successful. The Feed team sits at the heart of that mission, helping members discover ideas, connect, and find opportunity. As a Principal Product Manager on the Feed Relevance team, you’ll shape how cutting-edge machine learning and foundation models connect hundreds of millions of professionals to what matters most, helping define the future of relevance, trust, and engagement on LinkedIn.

sections.title: Job Description
paras: We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the next generation of AI-powered content understanding and quality systems that shape the LinkedIn Feed. This is a senior individual contributor role for a proven product leader who can define bold strategy, influence across disciplines, and deliver at massive scale.

In this role, you’ll shape how we leverage machine learning, large language models, and foundation models to understand the content shared on LinkedIn and translate that understanding into more relevant, valuable, and trustworthy recommendations. You’ll drive systems that identify high-quality content, surface meaningful professional insights, and reduce the distribution of low-quality or harmful content, balancing member value, engagement, and long-term ecosystem health.

You’ll partner deeply with AI Research, Engineering, Data Science, and Trust & Safety teams to develop and scale content understanding capabilities that power Feed ranking and recommendations. Beyond content understanding, you’ll have opportunities to influence the broader evolution of LinkedIn’s recommendation systems and deliver meaningful improvements to how millions of members discover content, conversations, and professional perspectives.
bullets: Define and execute the AI product strategy for content understanding and quality across LinkedIn Feed, partnering with PMs, Applied Research, Engineering, Data Science, and Trust & Safety to deliver measurable improvements in relevance, member value, and ecosystem health.

Lead the development of large-scale ML and foundation model-powered systems that understand content topics, intent, quality, credibility, and professional value, translating these insights into actionable signals for ranking and recommendation systems.

Drive the evolution of content quality and recommendation policies that amplify valuable, authentic content while reducing low-quality, misleading, or harmful content, balancing short-term engagement with long-term member trust and ecosystem health.

Translate member experience goals and business outcomes into clear model objectives, evaluation frameworks, and success metrics, ensuring alignment between AI capabilities, recommendation quality, and product strategy.

Partner with Applied Research and Infrastructure Engineering to advance scalable content understanding capabilities, including LLM-based classification, content representations, model evaluation, and efficient inference at LinkedIn scale.
Lead cross-functional product development, from problem definition and requirements through experimentation, policy alignment, model deployment, and launch.
Use data, experimentation, and qualitative insights to identify opportunities, evaluate model and policy performance, and continuously improve content quality and Feed relevance.

Collaborate with Feed ranking and personalization teams to integrate content understanding signals into end-to-end recommendation systems, influencing how content is retrieved, ranked, and distributed to members.
